g.text: Hey Lettie? Are you busy? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]
I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it.
It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you in any way.
I only hurt you the way you like it
Now what are you going on about
And what is there to get mad about?
And what is there to understand?
I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. I know it's not something we've discussed before. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.
What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.
I guess I just want to know
Do you really care about them, solecito?
I do care about them. But I also care very deeply about you.
I should have guessed you would have figured it out quickly.
Hard to blame you, when you see so much
Jajaja she is a terrible gossip
I would have to scrub myself with prep pads for a week
Hard to blame you, when you see so much
You have become very important to me, solecito
And if they bring you happiness?
Then they bring me the same
And find a way to bring them here someday
I'll see what I can do.
